traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are implemented and verified. The ESLint rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation share a common detection scope (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) with arrow functions excluded by default; they use consistent configuration (scope and exportPriority) and shared helper logic for scoping and TypeScript support. JSDoc and comment parsing for @story and @req are robust, handle edge cases, and are backed by extensive tests. Error messages are clear and anchored at or near the function name, with autofix/suggestions where appropriate. Documentation for both rules exists and matches the implemented behavior. All related Jest test suites pass, confirming the story’s functionality is fully delivered and stable.
